frame.name: local ENU from habitat
frame.note: east_m/north_m are ground metres from the habitat. lat/lon are planetocentric degrees, longitude positive east, Mars 2000 sphere (R = 3,396,190 m). x_m/y_m are coordinates in the DTM's equirectangular projection (standard parallel 0, central meridian 0). This is NOT RFC 7946 (Earth WGS84) GeoJSON.

units.relative_effort: hours of suit supply at 1200 BTU/h (model, see route_model.json)

field_definitions.max_slope_deg: steepest walking grade: slope in the direction the astronaut walks, cell to cell
field_definitions.max_terrain_slope_deg: steepest ground slope under the route (slope of the terrain in its own steepest direction; a route can cross it sideways)
field_definitions.m_walking_grade_steeper_than_20deg: metres where the walking grade exceeds 20 deg
field_definitions.m_terrain_steeper_than_20deg: metres on ground whose terrain slope exceeds 20 deg
field_definitions.m_steeper_than_20deg: metres where either of the two above exceeds 20 deg (used for warnings)
field_definitions.max_side_slope_deg: steepest side slope: the cross-slope the astronaut walks across, from tan(terrain)^2 = tan(grade)^2 + tan(side)^2. Neither the speed nor the effort model prices it unless SIDE_SLOPE_WEIGHT is above zero
field_definitions.m_side_slope_steeper_than_20deg: metres where the side slope exceeds the 20 deg reference
field_definitions.relative_effort: walking only, in hours of suit supply at 1200 BTU/h. Same as supply_h_walking
field_definitions.supply_h_science: supply spent standing at the stops: science_time_min at half the flat walking rate (Pandolf's standing term)
field_definitions.supply_h_total: supply_h_walking + supply_h_science. This is the figure to show, not relative_effort
field_definitions.supply_pct_of_suit: supply_h_total against an 8 h suit at the reference rate

segment_fields.nearest_safe_place_id: habitat or terrain shelter closest in walking time from the segment midpoint
segment_fields.time_to_nearest_safe_place_min: walking time (fastest route) from the segment midpoint to that place
